channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from PNallDR, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Tim Scott backs Graham ahead of South Carolina Senate runoff
item.description: Sen. Tim Scott said on 'Meet the Press' that Sen. Darline Graham is clearly qualified for the Senate, defending her before the runoff.

item.title: Karoline Leavitt announces next move after White House exit
item.description: Leavitt said on Air Force One she will join Trump's super PAC MAGA Inc. after leaving her role as press secretary.

item.title: El-Sayed criticized for posts targeting Usha Vance and female aide
item.description: Abdul El-Sayed's comments about Usha Vance and JD Vance's grandfather drew accusations of racism and sexism from Rep. Brandon Gill and others.

item.title: Mamdani's grocery plan may double NYC taxpayer costs
item.description: NYC taxpayers could pay twice under Zohran Mamdani's city-owned grocery plan, as grants for independent grocers are also considered.
